content.comment_body: Hello, I am working with two [product_name] modules. Both use input 7 and 8 as analog inputs (A1 and A2). I would like to access the values of the analog inputs from module 2 within the program of module 1. For this, I am trying to use a network analog input feature. In the properties, I select 'remote device', then the other module. However, I am unsure about which VW address to enter. How can I retrieve the value of an analog input from another module's program?
Attached is an example solution using a client/server connection.
I am already applying this approach, but I do not know which specific blocks to choose or what details should be entered into the analog network properties.
Please refer to the attached screen recording for guidance.
Thank you! Your assistance is greatly appreciated, and you frequently provide support to others—you're truly helpful!

analysis.insight_summary: Users face confusion when attempting to configure analog input sharing between two [product_name] modules, particularly regarding network analog input property settings and choosing the correct address value. Many are unsure about which configuration blocks to use and have difficulty navigating the setup in [product_name] programming software.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for a straightforward, easy-to-follow process for configuring networked analog inputs, including clear guidance on the necessary address values and configuration blocks.
